settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
The Packaged Part Holder (PPH) is available in 6 inch and 8 inch opening versions. A single leadscrew opens and closes the jaws, holding a variety of die, packaged parts, substrates, printed circuit boards and similar devices for probing applications.

Each holder comes with an adapter to mount on standard vacuum chucks and the wafer stage. It can also mount directly onto the wafer stage. The user has the option to move the PPH in X, Y, Z and theta. The jaws will also hold a wafer chuck, making it straightforward to test die, partial wafers and whole wafers.

settings.question: Which opening size should I choose?
settings.answer: Size for the largest part or board you need to hold. The 6 inch opening suits packaged devices and smaller boards; the 8 inch opening covers larger boards and panel-level work. A larger opening will still hold smaller parts.

settings.question: How does the holder mount to my station?
settings.answer: It comes with an adapter to mount on standard vacuum chucks and the wafer stage, and it can also mount directly onto the wafer stage. From there you can move it in X, Y, Z and theta.

settings.question: Can it hold a wafer chuck?
settings.answer: Yes. The jaws will hold a wafer chuck, which makes it straightforward to move between testing die, partial wafers and whole wafers without changing fixturing.

settings.question: What can the jaws hold?
settings.answer: Die, packaged parts, substrates, printed circuit boards and similar devices for probing applications — and a wafer chuck when you need one.

settings.heading: Probing Something Unusual?
settings.body: SemiProbe builds fixturing to order — custom jaw geometries, adapters and holders for packages, boards and substrates that standard fixturing will not take.
